scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream tunic and rust-brown mantle kneels beside an olive tree, looking upward with both hands open in prayer. Warm sunrise lights rocky ground, small flowers, distant blue hills and a stone village in a textured watercolor landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined worshipper and his open hands express the verse's earnest prayer and supplications. His hopeful upward gaze suggests reliance on the LORD's faithfulness and righteousness.
